ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the pricing cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionTitle.placeholder: Clear, upfront implementation with room to grow.

SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional. Short label displayed above the section title. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SectionEyebrowColor.helper: Choose a Bootstrap or portal.css text utility. Select a color with enough contrast against the section background.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Supporting text shown below the section title. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Every tier pairs an expert-led initial build with a dependable managed platform.

PricingCards.helper: Add pricing cards in display order. Featured cards receive the Most Popular label, a larger presentation, and a solid next-step button.

SolutionTitle.helper: Required. Short name for this pricing option. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SolutionEyebrow.helper: Required. Short category label shown above the solution title. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SolutionDescription.helper: Optional. Explain who this option is for. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SolutionDescription.placeholder: For businesses that want an expert team to manage the work from start to finish.

PriceBandColor.helper: Required. Sets the price band color and the matching eyebrow and next-step button contrast. Choose a color that supports readable text.

PriceText.helper: Required. Display the price or pricing phrase. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

PriceEyebrow.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the price. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SolutionMatchInnerCardText.helper: Optional. Add a short fit, philosophy, or discovery note inside the card. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SolutionMatchInnerCardText.placeholder: Ideal match: teams that want milestone reviews and expert guidance.

SolutionMatchInnerCardColor.helper: Optional. Sets the note background. The template selects a contrasting text color for common light and dark utilities.

NextStepText.helper: Optional. Button label. The button appears only when both this field and Next Step URL are valid.

NextStepURL.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. Local and external HTTP links are supported.

IsFeatured.helper: Optional. Marks this card as Most Popular, enlarges it slightly, and changes its next-step button to a solid style.

SolutionValuePropositions.helper: Required. Add one benefit per item. Each item displays with a green FontAwesome check icon.

items.helper: HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Short note centered below the pricing cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: All plans include managed hosting, updates, and support.
